name: atomfolio-menubar
description: AtomFolio menu bar companion — portfolio total and holding news at a glance.

scripts.start: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:main-libs && electron .
scripts.dev: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:main-libs && ATOMFOLIO_API_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8787 electron .
scripts.build:mac: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:main-libs && electron-builder --mac
